answer: The reef judges every seat's work each epoch and records which ivory account paid that seat's jade judging fee. Vote weight is the square of attested epochs, and the k-th seat funded by one ivory account earns one attested epoch per k epochs judged. An honest newcomer reaches weight 10,000 after 100 epochs and 100 jade. An operator's 20th clone needs 2,000 epochs and 2,000 jade to match it, 21,000 jade for all 20. Paying from unrelated ivory accounts means buying fees at their markup.
